items.stem: Copilot's summary lists an action item that no one actually agreed to in the meeting. What should you do?

options.text: Remove it and keep the record to agreed commitments only
options.rationale: Correct: the record must reflect what was agreed, not what the model inferred.

options.text: Keep it because it sounds like a sensible task
options.rationale: Plausibility does not make it an agreed commitment.

options.text: Assign it to whoever spoke last
options.rationale: Guessing an owner compounds the fabricated action.

options.text: Leave it unassigned in the notes
options.rationale: An unagreed action does not belong in the record at all.

items.explanation: Correct: the record must reflect what was agreed, not what the model inferred.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO attributes must every Planner task carry to support accountability? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: a named owner is who is accountable for delivery.
Correct: a due date makes progress and lateness visible.

options.text: A colour label matching the meeting theme
options.rationale: Colour is cosmetic and does not drive accountability.

options.text: A copy of the full transcript
options.rationale: Attaching the transcript does not make the task actionable.

items.explanation: Correct: a named owner is who is accountable for delivery.

items.stem: When is a reminder before a due date proportionate?

options.text: Timed to give the owner room to act, not daily nagging
options.rationale: Correct: a well-timed reminder supports delivery without noise.

options.text: Sent every day from the moment the task is created
options.rationale: Daily nagging trains people to ignore reminders.

options.text: Only after the task is already overdue
options.rationale: A reminder only after lateness defeats its purpose.

options.text: Sent to the whole team for each individual task
options.rationale: Broadcasting every reminder creates noise and dilutes ownership.

items.explanation: Correct: a well-timed reminder supports delivery without noise.
